title: GraphFrame
tagline: We are giving the address from ENS Domain . We are using The Graph
description: We are asking the users to give their ENS Domain . Then after we get the domain we are using graph query to fetch the address of user. So what the problem is there  is no method in frame to fetch  or get the address of user . So we are solving that issue by using ens domain. We used query of the Graph .
how_its_made: The project is made by using two tech stack which is TheGraph and Nextjs . We are  also using frog for testing the frame . We have used parteners like The Graph for the query as we easily  can easily fetch the address from the query. Every time the user put their address they get the address .
